The Doctor

Dr. Arnoud Noot, DDS

Dr. Arnoud Noot (pronounced "Note") has been practicing biomimetic dentistry in American Fork, Utah for over 18 years. He is recognized as "the most scientifically advanced dentist in the state of Utah" by the Academy of Biomimetic Dentistry.

A Different Philosophy

Dr. Noot believes it's better to protect a tooth than repair it. When repair is necessary, his biomimetic approach preserves your natural tooth structure instead of destroying it like traditional dentistry.

"I take the time to explain and show exactly what needs to be done. My patients understand their treatment because I don't overbook my schedule. Each patient receives the time and attention they deserve."

The Biomimetic Difference

While other dentists drill aggressively and place crowns that eventually fail, Dr. Noot uses microscope precision and biomimetic materials to create restorations that mimic your natural tooth structure. This approach has allowed him to practice for over 18 years without placing a single crown.

Credentials & Training

Dr. Noot's advanced training and certifications ensure the highest level of biomimetic dental care:

Academy of Biomimetic Dentistry

Member of the prestigious Academy, trained directly by the founders of biomimetic dentistry including Dr. David Alleman.

4 years of intensive dental training in the United States Air Force, developing precision and attention to detail.

Air Force Accommodation Medal

Utah Dental Society
